objective: Repair the review findings on the Pi root wiring in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-wiring (branch release/0.3.0/feat/pi-root-wiring, head 5307d43), with tests and accurate docs.
scope: Blocking 1 (code review): the provider probes run before KIMI_CODE_REGION is set: gather calls startProviderCheck (extension.ts ~808-818) but applyEnvironment(providerEnvironment) runs only in before_agent_start (~876), and Pi's exec inherits process env. Apply the provider environment before the probes start, and add a test asserting the env at probe time.

Blocking 2 (security): notice() only collapses whitespace and cuts to 400 characters, so ESC and C0/C1 control bytes from a project config's pi.routes.*.model (via ModelsNotInCatalog.brief) or from pi auth check output (outputDetail, ProviderInvalid.message) reach Pi's Markdown-rendered notice and the model. Strip C0/C1 controls (keep nothing that can start an escape sequence) in notice/oneLine, and restrict the model id in the config schema to a safe character set that still accepts real ids such as kimi-coding/kimi-for-coding; test both.

Blocking 3 (security): the root's exclusion is weaker than --exclude-tools and fails open. (a) If topOf (git), the config decode or the role decode fails, the root gets no exclusions and no root prompt: apply the root's default exclusions and the root prompt from the defaults when the config cannot be read (still show the notice). (b) setActiveTools only deactivates; Pi 1.5.0 agent-session.js _getCallableTools (~line 1176) lets codemode scripts call registered tools whose exposure is codemode or deferred whether active or not. Read how codemode, the computer-use, Moonshot and web packages register their tools (pinned sources via npm pack into /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad if not in node_modules) and, where an excluded tool stays callable, block it for the root through Pi's tool_call event (or the equivalent Pi API) so a call to an excluded tool is refused; test it. Say which tools needed the block.

Optional (include): a missing pi binary (ENOENT, mapped by Pi exec to code 1) must not produce a false not-logged-in notice: treat a probe that did not start as no notice, matching the existing cannot-start rule; the setActiveTools-failure notice is dropped when the status context is the delivery (extension.ts:818): deliver both; a compaction that lands before the start collection ends drops applyRootTools and the probes: make the start work run once regardless.

Docs (artifact review): docs/pi/providers.md:107 still says the root prompt is planned; README.md status table and Provider decision row and providers.md say KIMI_CODE_REGION is set at session start (make them match the repaired code); extensions.md and providers.md say the probes share the collection's deadline (they have their own deadline of the same length); extensions.md says a throwing setActiveTools is reported (make it true); extensions.md: the agent generator, not the extension, leaves mcp__ entries out of agent files; the 'root only' intro should say the provider environment covers children too. Also docs/pi/extensions.md:130-142 says toolSettings is planned and docs/usage.md lists no tool-settings step: the next branch (release/0.3.0/feat/pi-tool-settings) writes them, so leave those two for it.
constraints: Change only the ownership paths; no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/.
Follow .claude/CLAUDE.md code rules; every behavior gets a test that fails without it; do not weaken tests.
Never run pi or a live provider.
Run bunx --no-install mise run build and bunx --no-install mise run verify before reporting.

Report in under 400 words; put long logs in a file under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad and give its path. Write a diff-file (dist excluded) at /home/user/holyagent-notes/wire-a-repair.diff.
